rationale: The assistant correctly framed the 10-minute cut-out/restart as an overheat cycle from restricted airflow, led with filter and hose checks, and once the customer revealed the crushed hose it identified that as 'very likely the cause' and gave the right fix (pull forward, reroute/replace hose, supervised test, engineer only if it persists with clear airflow). It handled the landlord situation sensibly and never recommended an internal part. Minor weaknesses: the second and third safety panels about 'tripping your electrics' do not match anything the customer reported, the unplug/reroute/supervised-test steps were restated in each reply, and declining the brief attended hose-off test removed a legitimate (if non-essential) diagnostic.
